column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying each patient (e.g., 'PAT001').
A SMALLINT indicating the patient's age in years.
An enum (patientgender_enum) for the patient's gender (Other, F, M).
An enum (patientethnicity_enum) indicating the patient's ethnicity (Other, Hispanic, African, Asian, Caucasian).
An enum (educationlevel_enum) describing highest education achieved (High School, Other, Bachelor, Master, Doctorate).
An enum (employmentstatus_enum) capturing employment status (Retired, Employed, Unemployed, Disabled, Student).
An enum (maritalstatus_enum) describing marital status (Widowed, Married, Single, Divorced).
An enum (livingarrangement_enum) for living arrangement (Alone, Partner, Family, Group Home, Homeless).
An enum (insurancetype_enum) referencing type of insurance (Medicaid, Medicare, Private).
An enum (insurancestatus_enum) describing insurance status (Pending, Approved, Denied).
An enum (disabilitystatus_enum) indicating disability status (Pending, Permanent, Temporary).
An enum (housingstability_enum) describing housing stability (Homeless, Stable, At Risk, Unstable).
An enum (culturalfactors_enum) capturing relevant cultural factors (Language, Beliefs, Family, Multiple).
An enum (stigmaimpact_enum) describing stigma impact (Moderate, Mild, Severe).
An enum (financialstress_enum) describing financial stress level (Severe, Mild, Moderate).
